title: Volunteer as a tutor
intro: You do not need an account. A volunteer is verified on exactly the same basis as a paid tutor.
weeklyHours: Hours a week you can give
weeklyHoursHint: Be realistic. A volunteer who is over-committed stops turning up, and the family that loses those sessions is the one that could not pay for them.
motivation: Why do you want to volunteer?
motivationHint: In your own words, in any language. Stored exactly as you write it.
received: Your application has been recorded and the team has been notified. Verification is the same process a paid tutor goes through.
